Since then, he has been campaigning and continuing his full Sharpe by visiting all 62 counties across the state. He has also entered the race for the Republican nomination in which he needs over 15,000 signatures to primary Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman. He has chosen Lewis County Sheriff Michael Carpinelli as his lieutenant governor candidate in the Republican Party primary race.

blocks.text: In the first round, Braiman and NOTA both received nine votes, while O’Neill received two votes. O’Neill was dropped from the ballot. blocks.text: In addition to nominees, the State Committee elected positions on the Elections Oversight Committee, which will oversee the election of the 2026-2028 LPNY State Committee. Samuel Hordeski, Steven Becker, and Andrew Kolstee were elected to the committee and join Chair Duane Whitmer as members of the committee. After the committee meets, there will be an announcement for anyone interested in running for State Committee to register to be a candidate.
